```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(car)
library(agricolae)
library(patchwork)
```

# Read in Data

```{r}
d <- read.csv('../Data/inputs/Biomass.csv') %>% 
  filter(., !Sterility=='?') 
d$Condition <- gsub(' ','',d$Condition)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('FF','Fertilized_Fertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('UF','Unfertilized_Fertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('FU','Fertilized_Unfertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('UU','Unfertilized_Unfertilized',d$Fertilization)

d <- d %>%
mutate(Condition = as_factor(Condition)) %>%
mutate(Condition = fct_relevel(Condition, "No_Plant", "Wild", "Modern"))
table(d$Condition)
d <- d %>%
mutate(Fertilization = as_factor(Fertilization)) %>%
mutate(Fertilization = fct_relevel(Fertilization, "Unfertilized_Unfertilized","Unfertilized_Fertilized",  "Fertilized_Unfertilized",  "Fertilized_Fertilized"))
table(d$Fertilization)

d.s <- filter(d, Sterility == "Sterile")
d.n <- filter(d, Sterility == "Not_Sterile")

n.shoot <- filter(d.n, Type=='Shoot')
n.root <- filter(d.n, Type == 'Root')
s.shoot <- filter(d.s, Type=='Shoot')
s.root <- filter(d.s, Type == 'Root')
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
```

# Shoot Biomass

## Sterile

### Shoot
```{r}
mod <- lm(Biomass_g ~ Fertilization*Condition, data = s.shoot)
plot(mod)
Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Condition ~ Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Condition|Fertilization)

# emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Harvest)

emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Condition*Fertilization), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Condition, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Condition'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```

```{r}
p.ss <- ggplot(aes(x=Fertilization, y=emmean, fill = Condition), data = df) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9),width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('yellow3','darkorange2','darkblue'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -1, hjust = 0) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Biomass (g)")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p.ss
```

### Root
## Model
```{r}
mod <- lm((Biomass_g) ~ Fertilization*Condition, data = s.root)
plot(mod)
Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Condition ~  Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Condition|Fertilization)

# emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Harvest)

emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Condition*Fertilization), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Condition, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Condition'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```

```{r}
p.sr<- ggplot(aes(x=Fertilization, y=response, fill = Condition), data = df) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9),width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = response-SE, ymax = response+SE))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('yellow3','darkorange2','darkblue'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -1, hjust = 0) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Biomass (g)")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.0,0.5))+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p.sr
```

```{r}
p.ss/p.sr + plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect") + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r}
bio_wide <- pivot_wider(bio, names_from = Type, values_from = Biomass_g) %>% 
  mutate(., Ratio = Root/Shoot)
```

## Model

```{r}
mod <- lm(log(Ratio) ~ Sterility*Fertilization*Condition, data = bio_wide)
plot(mod)

aov_mod <- aov(mod)
summary(aov_mod) 
```

## Graph

```{r}
sum_rs <-summarise(group_by(bio_wide,Sterility, Fertilization, Condition),
  n = n(),
  mean = mean(Ratio),
  sd = sd(Ratio),
  se = sd/sqrt(n))

sum_rs$Condition <- gsub(' ','',sum_rs$Condition)

p3<-ggplot(sum_rs, aes(Fertilization, mean, fill = Condition)) +
  facet_wrap(~Sterility)+
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Paired', breaks=c("No_Plant","Wild","Modern")) +  
  labs(y='Root-to-Shoot Ratio (g/g)')+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-se, ymax = mean+se),position=position_dodge(0.9), width = .25)+
 theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title=element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p3
ggsave(plot=p2, '../Data/R_PPT_figs/rootbiomass.png',height=6,width=10)
```
